fields.name: BitsPerSample
fields.description: Number of bits used for each image component.

fields.name: Orientation
fields.description: How the stored pixels should be oriented for display.

fields.name: RowsPerStrip
fields.description: Rows in each TIFF image-data strip.

fields.name: StripByteCounts
fields.description: Byte counts of TIFF image-data strips.

fields.name: ResolutionUnit
fields.description: Unit used for XResolution and YResolution.

fields.name: Software
fields.description: Software or firmware that created or modified the image.

fields.name: DateTime
fields.description: Last image-modification date and time; EXIF does not require a timezone.

fields.name: WhitePoint
fields.description: Chromaticity of the image white point.

fields.name: JPEGInterchangeFormat
fields.description: Offset of the embedded JPEG thumbnail.

fields.name: JPEGInterchangeFormatLength
fields.description: Length of the embedded JPEG thumbnail.

fields.name: YCbCrCoefficients
fields.description: Matrix coefficients used to transform RGB to YCbCr.

fields.name: YCbCrPositioning
fields.description: Position of subsampled chroma relative to luminance.

fields.name: ReferenceBlackWhite
fields.description: Reference black and white component values.

fields.name: FNumber
fields.description: Lens f-number used for the exposure.

fields.name: SpectralSensitivity
fields.description: Spectral sensitivity of the camera sensor.

fields.name: DateTimeOriginal
fields.description: Date and time when the original image was captured; timezone may be separate.

fields.name: DateTimeDigitized
fields.description: Date and time when the image was digitized.

fields.name: ComponentsConfiguration
fields.description: Meaning and order of image components.

fields.name: CompressedBitsPerPixel
fields.description: Compression mode expressed in bits per pixel.

fields.name: MaxApertureValue
fields.description: Smallest lens f-number, encoded as an APEX value.

fields.name: SubjectDistance
fields.description: Distance to the subject in metres.

fields.name: Flash
fields.description: Flash status and mode bit field.

fields.name: FocalLength
fields.description: Actual lens focal length in millimetres.

fields.name: RelatedSoundFile
fields.description: Name of a related sound file.

fields.name: ExposureIndex
fields.description: Exposure index selected by the camera.

fields.name: ExposureMode
fields.description: Exposure mode selected by the camera.

fields.name: GPSLatitude
fields.description: Latitude as degrees, minutes, and seconds.

fields.name: GPSLongitude
fields.description: Longitude as degrees, minutes, and seconds.

fields.name: GPSAltitudeRef
fields.description: Whether altitude is above or below sea level.

fields.name: GPSTimeStamp
fields.description: UTC time from the GPS receiver.

fields.name: GPSImgDirection
fields.description: Direction of the image when captured.

fields.name: GPSMapDatum
fields.description: Geodetic survey data used by the receiver.

fields.name: GPSDateStamp
fields.description: UTC date from the GPS receiver.

fields.name: GPSDifferential
fields.description: Whether differential GPS correction was used.

fields.name: RelatedImageFileFormat
fields.description: File format of the related image.
